name: Negative control: benign directory listing (no T1087.001 detection)
description: Benign administrative activity (listing /tmp and printing the date) on a Linux lab endpoint. Ground truth: NOT account discovery. Any qualifying T1087.001 detection is a false positive; correct silence under healthy monitoring is a true negative.

mapping_evidence.note: Negative control: benign activity, must not produce a T1087.001 detection. Required log source process_creation (rule 100110).
mapping_evidence.logtest: wazuh-logtest v4.14.9 on a real lab-linux-01 event: "snoopy[961]: [uid:1001 sid:955 tty:(none) cwd:/ filename:/usr/bin/cat]: cat /etc/passwd" -> decoder jisrsec-snoopy (uid, sid, tty, cwd, filename, command) -> rule 100110 level 3 groups jisrsec,linux,process_creation,snoopy. Telemetry only (no ATT&CK ID).
